zh.title: 台灣國籍航空國際線燃油附加費9月7日起調漲
zh.summary: 因航空燃油價格上漲，台灣國籍航空國際線附加費將於9月7日起再度調漲。
body: 台灣交通部民用航空局於2026年9月1日宣布，由於國際航空燃油價格持續上漲，國籍航空器的國際航線客運燃油附加費，將自9月7日起再度調漲。短程航線將調升至32.5美元，長程航線則調升至84.5美元。民航局已要求業者充分揭露資訊以維護權益。
根據中油公司同日公告，國際航空燃油價格自每桶147.57美元調漲至156.79美元，使計價級距由第12級調整至第13級。在此之前，民航局曾於8月3日宣布自8月9日起調漲附加費，當時油價升至每桶147.57美元，短程與長程附加費分別調升至30美元及78美元。

en.title: Taiwan CAA Announces International Fuel Surcharge Increase Starting September 7
en.summary: Taiwan passenger fuel surcharges to rise on September 7 due to higher aviation fuel prices.
body: The Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) of Taiwan announced on September 1, 2026, that passenger fuel surcharges for international flights operated by Taiwanese airlines will increase starting September 7, 2026. Under the new adjustment, the fuel surcharge for short-haul routes will rise to $32.50, while long-haul routes will increase to $84.50. The regulatory authority has instructed carriers to fully disclose this information to safeguard consumers.

According to CPC Corporation's announcement, international aviation fuel prices rose from $147.57 to $156.79 per barrel, shifting the pricing bracket from level 12 to level 13. This marks the second consecutive monthly adjustment, following an increase announced on August 3, 2026, which took effect on August 9, where short-haul and long-haul surcharges rose to $30 and $78 respectively.

zh.title: FAA完成eIPP計畫首次遙控混合動力貨運飛機測試飛行
zh.summary: FAA宣佈Elroy Air於路易斯安那州完成首次eIPP遙控貨運試飛。
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）宣佈，飛行器開發商 Elroy Air 與路易斯安那州交通暨發展部於2026年8月，在美國路易斯安那州的霍馬-特勒博恩機場（HUM）完成了混合動力電動遠端遙控飛行器的貨運展示飛行。
根據 FAA 發布的資訊，這次試飛是該機構「電動垂直起降整合試點計畫」（eIPP）架構下，首次執行的遠端遙控飛行器測試飛行。該試點計畫源自「釋放無人機主導地位」行政命令，美國交通部於2026年3月選出跨越26個州的八個參與計畫，路易斯安那州交通暨發展部為其中之一。
本次測試使用的是 Elroy Air 開發的 Chaparral 飛行器。該型機為一種高度自動化的混合動力垂直起降（eVTOL）系統，專為在非傳統場地之間進行重型貨物空中運輸而設計。Elroy Air 執行長 Andrew Clare 表示，Chaparral 的設計宗旨是在最需要的地點執行自主重型貨運，包括離岸能源平台、工業供應鏈、災害應變以及傳統基礎設施無法抵達的社區。
FAA 署長 Bryan Bedford 表示，這項展示飛行提供了實務數據，有助於將先進空中交通概念從試驗階段推向實際部署，並展示新型飛行器如何擴大全美社區的貨運選項與改善物流基礎設施。FAA 表示將利用這些測試數據識別規範漏失與程序缺口，支援將遠端遙控貨運飛行器安全整合至美國國家空域系統中。

en.title: FAA Announces First Remotely-Piloted eVTOL Cargo Flight Under eIPP
en.summary: FAA and Elroy Air completed the first remotely piloted cargo demonstration flight under eIPP in Louisiana.
body: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) announced that developer Elroy Air and the Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development conducted a hybrid-electric demonstration flight at Houma-Terrebonne Airport (HUM) in Louisiana, United States, to evaluate cargo delivery capabilities using a remotely piloted aircraft.

According to official statements from the agency, this test flight marks the first remotely piloted aircraft flight conducted under the FAA's eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP). The eIPP initiative was established as part of President Trump's Unleashing Drone Dominance Executive Order to create large-scale testing environments for next-generation aircraft. In March 2026, the U.S. Department of Transportation selected eight participating projects across 26 states, with the Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development designated as one of the state-level program participants.

The flight test was conducted using Elroy Air's Chaparral aircraft, which is configured as a highly automated hybrid-electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) system designed to move heavy air cargo between non-traditional landing sites. Elroy Air Chief Executive Officer Andrew Clare stated that the Chaparral was designed to transport heavy payloads autonomously for applications including offshore energy platforms, industrial supply chain logistics, disaster response efforts, and communities that lie beyond traditional transport infrastructure.

FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford emphasized that the demonstration provides critical data to support transitioning Advanced Air Mobility concepts from experimental trials to operational deployment. Bedford noted that such test flights demonstrate how new aircraft types can expand cargo transport options across the nation and improve general logistics infrastructure. The FAA indicated it will analyze operational findings from these eIPP flights to identify regulatory and procedural gaps, helping ensure the safe integration of autonomous cargo aircraft into the National Airspace System as additional test flights proceed through the rest of the year.

zh.title: JetZero獲得一億美元融資 推進Z4翼身融合飛機研發
zh.summary: JetZero獲得一億美元貸款；用於推進Z4翼身融合飛機研發與產能設施建設
body: 美國航空新創公司JetZero於2026年8月31日宣佈，已透過優先擔保定期貸款機制獲得一億美元的新增資金。本次融資由投資機構Pinegrove Credit Partners領投，並獲得Brookfield與HRTG Partners支持，矽谷銀行（First-Citizens Bank旗下部門）亦參與其中。
JetZero表示，這筆資金將用於持續推進Z4翼身融合飛機（Blended Wing Body）的開發計畫。該機型設計載客量約為250人，航程可達5000海里。JetZero執行長Tom O'Leary指出，該筆貸款融資將直接用於資助位於北卡羅來納州的工具製造與生產設施。

en.title: JetZero Secures $100 Million Loan Facility for Blended Wing Body Aircraft
en.summary: JetZero secures $100 million in debt financing to fund Z4 blended wing body aircraft development.
body: JetZero announced on August 31, 2026, that it has secured $100 million in additional capital through a senior secured term loan facility. The financing deal was led by investment firm Pinegrove Credit Partners, backed by Brookfield and HRTG Partners, along with Silicon Valley Bank, a division of First-Citizens Bank.

The funds will be utilized to advance the development of the Z4, a blended wing body aircraft designed to carry approximately 250 passengers over range distances of 5,000 nautical miles. JetZero Chief Executive Officer Tom O'Leary stated that the loan facility will directly fund tooling and production facilities in North Carolina.

zh.title: 土耳其F-16戰機緊急起飛 應對無人機侵入愛沙尼亞領空
zh.summary: 駐愛沙尼亞土耳其F-16戰機緊急起飛；軍方針對無人機入侵發布空中威脅警報
body: 愛沙尼亞國防軍（EDF）表示，部署於愛沙尼亞埃馬里空軍基地（Ämari Air Base）的土耳其空軍 F-16 戰鬥機，於 2026 年 9 月 1 日清晨緊急起飛。這起行動是在多架無人機越境進入愛沙尼亞領空後發起，愛沙尼亞全國性空中威脅警報隨後於當地時間上午 6 時前解除。
根據愛沙尼亞國防軍發布的訊息，軍方於凌晨 3 時 11 分向萊內-維魯縣與伊達-維魯縣居民發送 EE-ALARM 細胞廣播警報，提醒民眾若發現無人機應立即採取避難措施。該警報範圍於凌晨 3 時 48 分進一步擴大至塔爾圖、約蓋瓦、維爾揚迪、瓦爾加、沃魯及普爾瓦等縣。愛沙尼亞政府危機資訊網站 kriis.ee 紀錄顯示，全國警報最終於上午 5 時 30 分正式結束。

愛沙尼亞國防軍戰略溝通部門負責人烏庫·阿羅爾德（Uku Arold）上校接受公共廣播機構 ERR 訪問時指出，相關無人機在進入愛沙尼亞領空前，曾沿著愛沙尼亞與拉脫維亞的東部邊境平行飛行，進而引發防空警報。國防軍目前尚未說明是否有無人機遭攔截，亦未透露相關飛行器的後續去向。愛沙尼亞外長馬爾古斯·查克納（Margus Tsahkna）在社交媒體 X 上表示，北大西洋公約組織（NATO）聯盟已迅速且按計畫作出反應。
本次起飛任務為 NATO 駐波羅的海防空任務運作下的首次緊急起飛。土耳其空軍第 181 中隊自駐地迪亞巴克爾派遣 5 架 F-16 戰鬥機與 76 名人員進駐埃馬里空軍基地，部署期將持續至 2026 年 11 月 30 日。在此同時，周邊國家亦採取防範措施，拉脫維亞國家武裝部隊對阿盧克斯內區發布橘色警報並緊急起飛盟軍戰機；芬蘭國防軍則於凌晨 4 時前在芬蘭灣東部劃設臨時航空與航海管制區。

en.title: Turkish F-16s Scramble After Drones Cross Into Estonia Airspace
en.summary: Turkish F-16 fighters scrambled from Estonia after drones crossed the country's eastern border.
body: Turkish Air Force F-16 fighter jets deployed to Ämari Air Base in Estonia scrambled early on September 1, 2026, after unidentified drones crossed into Estonian airspace, according to statements from the Estonian Defense Forces. The Estonian authorities initiated air threat warnings across multiple regions, with nationwide threat alerts officially lifted before 06:00 local time.

The Estonian Defense Forces transmitted an EE-ALARM cell broadcast notification to residents in Lääne-Viru and Ida-Viru counties at 03:11, advising individuals to seek shelter upon sighting any drone. The public warning area was subsequently expanded at 03:48 to encompass Tartu, Jõgeva, Viljandi, Valga, Võru, and Põlva counties. Data recorded on the government crisis website kriis.ee confirmed that the nationwide warning concluded at 05:30.

Colonel Uku Arold, head of the Estonian Defense Forces Strategic Communications Department, stated to public broadcaster ERR that the drones had operated parallel to the eastern borders of Estonia and Latvia prior to entering Estonian airspace. Military authorities have not confirmed whether any drone was intercepted or where the unmanned aircraft ultimately moved. Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna stated on X that NATO allied forces responded swiftly and as planned.

The interception launch marks the first scramble executed under NATO's Baltic air defense mission from Ämari. The Turkish deployment features five F-16 fighters and 76 personnel from the 181st Squadron based in Diyarbakır, with the rotation scheduled to continue through November 30, 2026. Simultaneously, Latvia's National Armed Forces issued an orange alert in Alūksne district while allied jets responded, and the Finnish Defense Forces established temporary airspace and maritime restrictions over the eastern Gulf of Finland.

zh.title: 據報波音737 MAX 10降價高達六成 實際售價傳低至5500萬美元
zh.summary: 波音737 MAX 10據報折扣達60%，實際售價低至5500萬美元。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，波音公司（Boeing）旗下 737 MAX 10 客機據傳正以高達 60% 的折扣進行銷售。雖然該機型的官方目錄牌價為 1.349 億美元，但實際出售價格傳出低至 5,500 萬美元。
相關交易報導涉及航空製造商的產品定價與市場銷售條件。由於上述售價資訊來自新聞報導，具體商業條款與交易細節仍有待市場後續觀察。
此外，根據波音公司先前公布的資料，波音 737-10 已於 2026 年 7 月完成認證飛行測試。該公司當時預計於 2026 年取得相關認證，並規劃在 2027 年開始進行交付。

en.title: Boeing Reportedly Discounting 737 MAX 10 Pricing By Up To 60 Percent
en.summary: Boeing is reportedly offering discounts of up to 60 percent on the 737 MAX 10.
body: According to a report by Simple Flying, Boeing is quietly discounting its 737 MAX 10 aircraft by up to 60 percent. Although the single-aisle model carries an official list price of 134.9 million dollars, sales prices are reportedly dropping to as low as 55 million dollars.

The reported pricing adjustments reflect commercial negotiations and competitive dynamics within the commercial aviation sector. The details regarding these transactional discounts remain based on media reporting rather than official pricing disclosures by the manufacturer.

In historical background, Boeing previously stated that certification flight testing for the 737-10 was completed as of July 2026. The planemaker continues to anticipate type certification in 2026, with initial customer deliveries planned to begin in 2027.

zh.title: 聯合航空App新功能 允許延誤旅客候補前三班航班
zh.summary: 聯合航空推出App新功能，允許班機延誤旅客候補最多三班較早航班。
body: 聯合航空推出了最新的手機應用程式功能，允許遭受航班延誤的旅客候補搭乘最多三班較早起飛的航班。這項新工具旨在協助預訂班機異動的乘客，能夠直接透過數位系統尋找並選擇提早出發的替代航班。
根據 Simple Flying 於2026年9月1日的報導，聯合航空趕在勞動節假期出遊尖峰期前，向其官方應用程式推出這些新功能。該軟體更新讓班機延誤的旅客能在搭乘受阻時，自行透過應用程式申請多達三班較早航班的候補資格。

en.title: United Airlines App Update Lets Delayed Passengers Stand By for 3 Earlier Flights
en.summary: United Airlines updates its mobile app to allow delayed passengers to stand by for earlier flights.
body: United Airlines has rolled out a new feature within its official mobile application that allows passengers affected by flight delays to put themselves on standby status for up to three earlier flights. This new tool is designed to assist delayed flyers seeking alternate travel options.

According to reporting by Simple Flying on September 1, 2026, these new features are arriving in the United Airlines application in time for the Labor Day travel rush. The updated software allows delayed passengers to request standby placement on up to three earlier flights directly through the app interface.

zh.title: IATA將於10月在布魯塞爾舉行第四屆世界永續高峰會
zh.summary: IATA將於10月在布魯塞爾舉辦永續高峰會，討論2050淨零碳排策略。
body: 國際航空運輸協會（IATA）宣布，第四屆世界永續高峰會（WSS）將於2026年10月13日至14日在比利時布魯塞爾舉行。本屆高峰會將匯聚來自航空業、能源界、金融機構、科技領域、學術界及政府部門的領袖，共同討論推動航空運輸業在2050年前實現淨零碳排放所需的政策與具體行動。
IATA永續發展高級副總裁兼首席經濟學家瑪麗·歐文斯·湯姆森（Marie Owens Thomsen）表示，航空業致力於達成2050年淨零碳排放目標，但能源轉型無法孤立進行。她強調，成功取決於擴大再生能源生產、建設新基礎設施、推進新穎技術、支持投資、轉移風險，並以整體系統思維設計相應政策。
本屆高峰會議程將聚焦於三大核心主題：第一，擴大航空能源轉型解決方案，重點包括氫化可再生酯和脂肪酸永續航空燃料（HEFA SAF）、低碳航空燃料（LCAF）及共加工技術；第二，設計與協調政策，以建立全球透明且具競爭力的SAF與碳信用市場；第三，推進技術創新，深入理解非二氧化碳效應及飛機全生命週期的永續性。
本次大會將首次與歐洲變革之翼（WOCE）會議在同一地點連續舉行，WOCE會議定於2026年10月15日登場。已確認出席的講者包括LATAM航空集團執行長羅貝托·阿爾沃（Roberto Alvo）、空中巴士永續監管與外部參與副總裁貝爾特朗·德·拉孔布（Bertrand de Lacombe）等多位產業與政法界專家。

en.title: IATA to Hold 4th World Sustainability Symposium in Brussels in October 2026
en.summary: IATA will host its fourth World Sustainability Symposium in Brussels to discuss aviation decarbonization policies.
body: The International Air Transport Association (IATA) announced that it will hold the fourth World Sustainability Symposium (WSS) in Brussels, Belgium, on October 13 and 14, 2026. The symposium will bring together leaders from aviation, energy, finance, technology, academia, and government to focus on the policies and concrete actions required to advance the air transport sector's transition toward net zero carbon emissions by 2050.

IATA Senior Vice President Sustainability and Chief Economist Marie Owens Thomsen noted that while the air transport industry remains committed to net zero carbon emissions by 2050, the energy transition cannot occur in isolation. She emphasized that achieving success depends on expanding renewable energy production for all sectors, building new infrastructure, advancing novel technologies, supporting investment, transferring risk, and designing policies with the overall aviation system in mind.

The event agenda will center on three core themes critical to decarbonization in aviation. These include scaling solutions for energy transition such as Hydroprocessed Esters and Fatty Acids Sustainable Aviation Fuel (HEFA SAF), Low Carbon Aviation Fuels (LCAF), and co-processing; designing and harmonizing policies that foster global and competitive markets for SAF and carbon credits; and advancing technical innovation, non-CO2 climate effects, and lifecycle sustainability.

For the first time, the World Sustainability Symposium and the Wings of Change Europe (WOCE) conference will be held consecutively at the same venue, with WOCE scheduled for October 15, 2026. Confirmed speakers for the event include LATAM Airlines Group Chief Executive Officer Roberto Alvo, Airbus Vice President Bertrand de Lacombe, and other representatives from industry, financial institutions, and regulatory authorities.

zh.title: Air Advisor評選倫敦希斯洛機場（LHR）為2026年全球最佳大型機場
zh.summary: Air Advisor公布2026年評比；倫敦希斯洛機場因準點率與Google評論登頂
body: 根據 Simple Flying 於2026年9月1日的報導，旅遊評估機構 Air Advisor 已將倫敦希斯洛機場（LHR）評選為2026年全球最佳大型機場。此項評比結果使該座倫敦主要的國際航空樞紐在全球大型機場中登頂。
Air Advisor 指出，航班準點率與 Google 評論的使用者回饋是促成希斯洛機場獲得第一名的主要原因。良好準點表現與 Google 評論的旅客評價，共同協助希斯洛機場在2026年評比中獲得首位。

en.title: Air Advisor Names London Heathrow (LHR) World's Best Major Airport for 2026
en.summary: Air Advisor names London Heathrow the world's best major airport for 2026, citing punctuality and Google reviews.
body: According to reporting by Simple Flying on September 1, 2026, travel platform Air Advisor has named London Heathrow Airport (LHR) as the world's best major airport for 2026. The new ranking places the major London air transport hub at the top spot among major airports across the globe.

Air Advisor stated that flight punctuality and user feedback from Google reviews were the main factors leading to the top position. Punctuality performance alongside customer sentiment in Google reviews enabled London Heathrow to secure the premier ranking in the 2026 global airport assessment.

zh.title: 波音與泰國民航局合作 導入勝任能力飛行員培訓方案
zh.summary: 波音與泰國民航局合作導入勝任能力培訓方案，提升泰國飛行員訓練品質。
body: 波音與泰國民航局（CAAT）於2026年9月1日宣布合作，將在泰國各地的飛行訓練機構導入波音的「勝任能力導向訓練與評估」（CBTA）學習教材庫方案。泰國民航局成為首個在整體訓練體系中採用該 CBTA 方案的航空主管機關。
波音指出，預計未來20年間東南亞將需要66,000名新飛行員。波音商業訓練方案副總裁 Chris Broom 表示，這項合作有助於提供未來飛行員在現代複雜航空環境中安全運作所需的技能與知識。泰國民航局人員執照處經理 Iratrachar Amornpipat 亦指出，引進波音 CBTA 方案將進一步提升泰國飛行員培訓品質與標準。

en.title: Boeing and Thailand CAAT Partner on Competency-Based Pilot Training
en.summary: Boeing and Thailand's Civil Aviation Authority partner to introduce competency-based pilot training solutions across Thai flight schools.
body: Boeing and the Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand (CAAT) announced a collaboration on September 1, 2026, to introduce Boeing’s Competency-Based Training and Assessment (CBTA) Learning Library solution across flight training organizations in Thailand. CAAT becomes the first aviation regulator to implement the CBTA Learning Library solution across an entire flight training ecosystem.

According to Boeing, Southeast Asia will require an estimated 66,000 new pilots over the next 20 years. Chris Broom, vice president of Boeing Commercial Training Solutions, stated that the partnership will equip future pilots with essential knowledge and competencies for modern aviation operations. CAAT Personnel Licensing Department Manager Iratrachar Amornpipat noted that leveraging Boeing's solution represents an important step in advancing pilot training standards across Thailand.
